verdicts.actual: FY26 revenue growth 11.8% (₹285,874 crore) vs 15% guidance
verdicts.evidence: reported financials FY26; Q4 FY26 call, p5
verdicts.verdict: Guidance held at 15% all year; delivered 11.8%. Missed, blamed on Q4 supply-chain slippage of ~Rs 50 billion.

verdicts.evidence: reported financials quarters ended Jun 2026, Sep 2026
verdicts.verdict: FY27 target 10-12% reaffirmed; weak Q1 offset by strong Q2, H1 roughly on track.
8.5% P&M margin guidance maintained through Q3 FY26; no FY26 actual P&M margin provided in facts.

verdicts.actual: FY26 PPM margin 7.8% per management; FY27 target ~7.8% reaffirmed Q1 FY27
verdicts.evidence: Q4 FY26 call, p7; Q1 FY27 call
verdicts.verdict: Target equals FY26 outcome; no FY27 interim PPM margin disclosed, so unverifiable so far.

verdicts.actual: 9M FY26 P&M EBITDA 7.9% vs 8.5% full-year target
verdicts.verdict: Management claimed 7.9% nine-month margin on track for 8.5%, but FY26 actual P&M margin absent from facts.

verdicts.actual: FY27 capex plan: electronics Rs 10bn, core PP&M Rs 25bn, data center Rs 20bn
verdicts.verdict: Capex plan stated May 2026; no spend updates in later facts. Note internal inconsistency vs Rs 1,000 crore data-center capex cited earlier.

verdicts.actual: FY26 order inflows: Q1 +33%, Q2 +45%, Q3 +17% (record Rs 1,356bn), Q4 broadly flat; order book +28% YoY
verdicts.evidence: Q1-Q3 FY26 calls; Q4 FY26 call, p5
verdicts.verdict: Guidance was to exceed 10% order inflow growth; nine-month momentum and 28% order-book growth indicate delivered.

verdicts.actual: FY27 order inflow guidance 10-12%, reaffirmed Q1 FY27
verdicts.evidence: Q4 FY26 call; Q1 FY27 call
verdicts.verdict: Reaffirmed July 2026; no FY27 order inflow figures provided yet, so unverifiable.

out.read: Revenue guidance missed despite four reaffirmations; order inflow delivered. Margins and FY27 targets lack disclosed outcomes, so trust guidance directionally, not precisely.
